## What is still open

- Elad approved #1412 but wants one change before merge: an audit event per batch (id range, count, from/to KEK), not only the final summary, because assessors want per-batch traceability under 10.2. Avi wants it merged by Monday so the prod run can happen Tuesday night [3]. Your current job emits a single end-of-run audit record [1].
- Prod window is confirmed for Tue 24/11, 22:00–23:30 IL time, with Elad on call with you. The fallback is Thu 26/11 at the same time, because the change freeze for the PCI on-site starts Tue 1/12 [6].
- Shira needs two things by Wed 25/11 for the assessor (Victor, Ardent): the export of the rotation job's audit log for the prod run, and the signed change ticket. Screenshots won't be accepted [5]. The per-batch audit events feed directly into this export [3][5].
- Deleting the old KEKs (2025 and 2022) is not decided. You kept them decrypt-only for 30 days and left deletion as a separate decision with Shira [1].

## What changed

- Dependabot opened a tokio 1.41.0 → 1.41.1 bump, which fixes a panic in `JoinSet::try_join_next` [4].

## What you did

- You built the KEK rotation job for the card vault (PCI 3.7.4) and opened #1412. It handles the pre-2023 v1 tokens by mapping them explicitly to `vault-kek-2022`. The staging dry run went from 2,317 failures to 0 out of 1,204,880 tokens [1].
- You wrote the prod runbook `docs/runbooks/vault-kek-rotation.md`, including the failure/rollback section [2].
